content: The Game Awards announced its 2026 nominations yesterday, though not without controversy. Grand Theft Auto 6 — a game that isn't even out yet — leads the pack with eight nominations, including Game of the Year. No indies managed to get a GOTY nomination this year, despite the release of acclaimed games like Mina the Hollower and Big Walk. Several blockbusters — including Polygon favorites like Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave and Pokémon Pokopia — were also snubbed for the night's biggest award.
